moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean hold UK Singles No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the top spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for an impressive 20th week, as new tracks from Ariana Grande and Sienna Spiro shake up the Top 10.

angles.name: Chart Topper Reign
angles.copy: 20 weeks at number one! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean are still reigning supreme on the Official UK Singles Chart with 'Rein Me In'. Who's gonna knock them off?

angles.name: New Entries & Climbers
angles.copy: New music alert! Ariana Grande climbs with 'Hate That I Made You Love Me' and 'Petal' is a fresh entry, while Sienna Spiro's 'Great Expectation' lands in the Top 10. What are you listening to this week?

moments.title: Mark Knopfler turns 77
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, legendary guitarist and frontman of Dire Straits, celebrates his 77th birthday today, known for hits like 'Sultans of Swing' and his distinctive fingerstyle guitar work.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the one and only Mark Knopfler! The Dire Straits legend, famous for his iconic guitar riffs and smooth vocals, is still making magic. What's your favourite Dire Straits track?

angles.name: Fingerstyle Icon
angles.copy: From 'Money For Nothing' to 'Sultans of Swing,' Mark Knopfler's fingerstyle guitar is instantly recognisable. Celebrating 77 years of a true music pioneer today!

moments.title: Culture Club's Roy Hay is 65
moments.blurb: Roy Hay, the guitarist and keyboardist of 80s pop icons Culture Club, celebrates his 65th birthday today.

angles.name: Culture Club Guitarist
angles.copy: Do You Really Want To Hurt Me? Not today! Happy 65th Birthday to Roy Hay, the brilliant guitarist and keyboardist from Culture Club! What's your top Culture Club anthem?

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Roy Hay of Culture Club turning 65! His unique sound helped define the 80s. Rewind to 'Karma Chameleon' and feel the nostalgia.

moments.title: EFL Championship season kicks off
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season begins on Friday, August 14th, with Wolverhampton Wanderers taking on Blackburn Rovers, marking the start of a new campaign for 24 clubs including Wrexham and Cardiff City.

angles.name: Championship Returns
angles.copy: Football is BACK! The EFL Championship kicks off this Friday, August 14th! Who are you backing for promotion this season?

angles.name: Wrexham & Cardiff Start
angles.copy: Huge week for Welsh football fans! Wrexham and Cardiff City begin their Championship campaigns on Monday 17th. Who's ready for some local derby action this season?

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: Premier League champions Arsenal face FA Cup winners Manchester City in the Community Shield on August 16th at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, a week before the new Premier League season.

angles.name: Season Curtain-Raiser
angles.copy: The first silverware of the season is up for grabs! Arsenal battle Man City in the Community Shield this Sunday, live from Cardiff. Who's taking home the trophy?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Principality Stadium in Cardiff hosts the Community Shield this Sunday! A huge match between Arsenal and Manchester City on Welsh soil. Who's heading to the capital?

moments.title: Queen's John Deacon turns 75
moments.blurb: John Deacon, the legendary bassist for Queen and writer of iconic hits like 'Another One Bites the Dust' and 'I Want to Break Free', celebrates his 75th birthday on August 19th.

angles.name: Queen Bassist Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the quiet genius of Queen, John Deacon, this Wednesday! The man behind some of their biggest hits. What's your favourite Deacon-penned track?

angles.name: Another One Bites The Dust
angles.copy: Celebrating John Deacon's 75th on August 19th! From 'Another One Bites the Dust' to 'I Want to Break Free,' his bass lines are pure gold. Give it up for Deacy!

moments.title: Robert Plant is 78
moments.blurb: Led Zeppelin frontman Robert Plant, whose powerful vocals defined a generation of rock music, celebrates his 78th birthday on August 20th.

angles.name: Golden God Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 78th Birthday to the legendary Golden God, Robert Plant! The voice of Led Zeppelin still reigns supreme. What's your ultimate Plant vocal moment?

angles.name: Led Zeppelin Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating 78 years of rock royalty! Robert Plant's incredible voice shaped Led Zeppelin's sound. Turn up 'Stairway to Heaven' and celebrate the icon this Thursday!

moments.title: Dua Lipa turns 31
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning global pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrates her 31st birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop Queen Birthday
angles.copy: Future Nostalgia Queen! Wishing Dua Lipa a very Happy 31st Birthday this Saturday! From 'New Rules' to 'Levitating,' she keeps serving hits. What's your favourite Dua track?

angles.name: Global Superstar
angles.copy: It's Dua Lipa's birthday on August 22nd! The global pop sensation turns 31. Get your dance moves ready to celebrate her incredible career!

moments.title: James Corden celebrates 48th birthday
moments.blurb: British actor, comedian, and former 'Late Late Show' host James Corden, known for 'Gavin & Stacey' and 'Carpool Karaoke', celebrates his 48th birthday on August 22nd.

angles.name: Carpool Karaoke King
angles.copy: Happy 48th Birthday to the multi-talented James Corden this Saturday! From Gavin & Stacey to Carpool Karaoke, he's given us so many laughs. Who was your favourite Carpool guest?

angles.name: UK's Favourite Comedian
angles.copy: Celebrating James Corden's 48th on August 22nd! A true British success story, making us laugh on both sides of the Atlantic. What's your favourite James Corden moment?

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 season starts
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off on Saturday, August 22nd, with reigning champions Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City, marking a later start due to the World Cup.

angles.name: Premier League Returns
angles.copy: Get ready, football fans! The Premier League is back this Saturday, August 22nd! Arsenal kick off against Coventry City. Who's your pick for the title this season?

angles.name: New Season Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League 2026/27 season starts this weekend. Fresh faces, new hopes, and 380 matches of pure drama ahead. What are your predictions for the opening weekend?

moments.title: Lorde headlines All Points East
moments.blurb: Lorde is set to headline All Points East festival at Victoria Park, London, on Saturday, August 22nd, as part of the ten-day music event.

angles.name: Lorde Live in London
angles.copy: London's calling! Lorde headlines All Points East this Saturday, August 22nd, bringing her atmospheric pop to Victoria Park. Who's got their tickets?

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: All Points East is just around the corner, and Lorde kicks off the main headline shows this Saturday! Get ready for a huge weekend of music in Victoria Park.
